purpose: Engineering comparison and discretization refinement; NOT an exact patch of the finite-mode connector
reference_identity: independent nu=0 3D Saint-Venant/Timoshenko section field; parabolic interface flux lies outside the five-mode multiplier space
known_model_discrepancy: Admissible delta_u_z=(z^2-t^2/12)/t has zero connector moments but parabolic shear does work -Q*t/30. Therefore mesh refinement cannot remove all interface modeling error. No retuning or exact-coupled claim allowed.
loads_and_supports: Native left edge all6 DOFs zero, right edge total force_z=Q using consistent line weights. Solid lateral surfaces free, no body load; two weak transitions with explicit multiplier knots[0,1]. No K*u reference loading.
sampling: solid quadrature points with0.25<=x<=0.75; retain per-component errors and interface-layer distinction

acceptance.coarse_levels: diagnostic errors, not required to meet final accuracy
acceptance.interpretation: Meeting targets supports only this engineering comparison; plateau/modeling error and actual mixed-interface independent reference remain open. Any failed finest target is retained as NO_GO; do not change limits or exclude samples after observing results.
